answer: Spectral Port Attestation. Each agent identity must ship a hardware-attested measurement of a unique physical port (its RF gale signature, optical umber band, and timing delta vs. a reference clock), signed by a tamper-resistant module. The registry rejects any tuple whose measured bands and delta collide with an existing record. An attacker cannot fake those physical values for N identities without N distinct modules and physical ports, so per-identity cost is one module plus one real port, and bulk registration fails at hardware supply.
